ValidationRule.description: Validation rule created for respecting the required format for the field ER_Registration_Number__c.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ER_Company_Account_RT' && ER_SmartER_Context__c = True && ISPICKVAL( ER_Country_Code__c , 'FR') && NOT(REGEX( ER_Registration_Number__c, "[0-9]{14}"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Registration Number field must be 14 digits long without space.
